standard.scoring: Score VPs equal to Enemy Supply destroyed this Round. From the start of the second Round: gain 1 VP for each Controlled Mission Marker; gain an additional 2 VPs for a Marker if you gained Control of it from the Opponent this Round.

skirmish.scoring: Same as Standard: Enemy Supply destroyed = VPs. From Round 2: 1 VP per Controlled Marker, +2 VPs for a Marker taken from the Opponent this Round.
